description: Returns the pull request title format and body from .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md. Use before gh pr create or when opening PRs manually so the description follows the project standard. Optional fields fill the template (change_type, description, task_id, type, title_description, include_visual_evidence, references).

change_type.description: Marks the corresponding checkbox in the template body.

include_visual_evidence.description: When false, omits the Evidências Visuais section. Default true when omitted.

project_root.description: Optional absolute path to the repo root containing .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md. If omitted, resolves from cwd or the mcp-runrunit package.

references.description: Optional links for the Referências section.

task_id.description: Task id for the PR title (e.g. task0123).

title_description.description: Short description for the PR title.

type.description: Conventional type for the PR title (e.g. feat, fix, docs).

name: runrunit_get_pr_template
